parsed.post: Latest experiment with DEPTH=10 resulted in val_bpb 1.034757, which is worse than my previous best of 1.014311. It seems increasing depth without sufficient LR or batch size adjustment causes divergence or poor convergence within the 5-minute window. Reverting to DEPTH=8.
parsed.description: Reverting to DEPTH=8 and slightly increasing MATRIX_LR to 0.04 to see if higher learning rate helps maximize training throughput within the time limit.
